answer: The ridge counter is kept in timber and forge shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 206 aliases cost 190 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
